# Chapter One — The Clock at Low Tide

At six in the morning, Mara heard the harbor clock strike seven. She wrote the mismatch in her notebook and kept walking.

The red paper boat appeared beneath the same lamp for the third Tuesday in a row.

# Chapter Two — A Dream Kept Separate

Mara dreamed that the lighthouse folded into a suitcase. When she woke, the suitcase was not in the room; only the notebook lay open beside her.

By five that afternoon, she told Ivo they had met at noon, although the meeting occurred at two.

# Chapter Three — Clear Water

They returned the borrowed key, checked the door, and watched the tide cover their footprints. Neither of them spoke. The red paper boat drifted out of the harbor.
